title: 1RB1LD_0RC0LF_1LD1RE_0LA0RB_0RD1RB_0LD---: the visit law runs to round 4,000,000 without a halt
text: A pipelined simulator of the Lean-proved visit law (c/visp.c; several rounds in flight at once, the prefix (1010)j passed in one jump by the Lean lemma visN_rep1010) ran rounds 1 to 4,000,000, twenty times further than before. No visit meets 111, the only way this machine can halt. A visit meets 1011 20 times, always at the right end of the word; the PR59 machines, which share the first four rules, halt the first time this happens (round 161,211).
